- Preserve decimals and convert commas to dots for numeric fields:
  - 10% group: Vat.Rate 10, Net.Amount 17585.57, Vat.Amount 1758.56.
  - 20% group: Vat.Rate 20, Net.Amount 899.47, Vat.Amount 179.89.

Step 6 — Handle schema constraints and no-inference rule
- Extracted values are taken directly from visible invoice text (no guessing).
- Where multiple VAT groups exist, both groups are identified as distinct occurrences (evidence kept).
